nodes.name: launch_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests covering agent-org launch validation and runtime override resolution, including duplicate/missing member id and definition checks.

nodes.name: launch_overrides_apply_recursively_to_effective_org_snapshot
nodes.summary: Tests that member launch overrides recursively apply to the effective agent org snapshot.

nodes.name: launch_overrides_reject_unknown_member_ids
nodes.summary: Tests that launch overrides referencing unknown member ids are rejected.

nodes.name: member_runtime_resolution_prefers_member_config_then_falls_back
nodes.summary: Tests that member runtime resolution prefers explicit member config before falling back to defaults.

nodes.name: launch_validation_rejects_agent_org_with_missing_member_definition
nodes.summary: Tests that launch validation rejects an agent org referencing a missing member agent definition.

nodes.name: launch_validation_rejects_cli_member_before_run_materialization
nodes.summary: Tests that CLI-sourced members are rejected before run materialization.

nodes.name: launch_validation_rejects_duplicate_member_ids
nodes.summary: Tests that launch validation rejects agent orgs with duplicate member ids.

nodes.name: launch_validation_rejects_reserved_and_empty_member_ids
nodes.summary: Tests that launch validation rejects reserved or empty member ids.

nodes.name: launch_workspace.rs
nodes.summary: Prepares the Rust-agent workspace (worktree checkout/isolation) for a session launch and manages per-work-item execution locks that prevent concurrent agents from operating on the same work item.

nodes.name: prepare_rust_agent_workspace_for_launch
nodes.summary: Prepares the working directory for a launching Rust agent session, optionally creating an isolated git worktree on a branch.

nodes.name: acquire_work_item_execution_lock
nodes.summary: Acquires an exclusive execution lock for a work item so only one agent session can work on it at a time.

nodes.name: release_work_item_execution_lock_if_present
nodes.summary: Releases a work item's execution lock if the given session currently holds it.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Core agent session launch orchestrator: defines launch request/result types and implements launch_agent_session and launch_rust_agent_run, which validate, create, and start sessions (including agent-org multi-member launches) and kick off the first turn.

nodes.name: generate_title_before_first_turn
nodes.summary: Generates a session title synchronously before the first turn is sent, used when title generation must complete prior to the launch response.

nodes.name: spawn_session_title_generation
nodes.summary: Spawns an async task to generate a session title in the background after launch.

nodes.name: launch_agent_session
nodes.summary: Tauri-facing entry point that validates a launch request and dispatches to the appropriate agent or agent-org launch path.

nodes.name: launch_rust_agent_run
nodes.summary: Main launch implementation for a native Rust agent run: resolves resources, prepares the workspace, creates the session record, and starts execution for a single agent or an entire agent org.

nodes.name: AgentRunLaunchRequest
nodes.summary: Request payload describing everything needed to launch a new agent run, including target, resources, and workspace.

nodes.name: AgentRunTarget
nodes.summary: Enum selecting whether a launch targets a single agent definition or a full agent org.

nodes.name: LaunchOrgContext
nodes.summary: Identifies the project and org context under which an agent org launch occurs.

nodes.name: LaunchResourceSelection
nodes.summary: Specifies the model, account, and harness resources to use for a launch.

nodes.name: WorkspaceLaunchTarget
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing a plain local workspace launch target from an isolated git worktree target.

nodes.name: LaunchProvenance
nodes.summary: Enum recording what triggered a session launch: a user session, a work item, or a routine/scheduled fire.

nodes.name: LaunchReturnStatus
nodes.summary: Enum representing whether a launch left the session idle or already started its first turn.

nodes.name: AgentRunLaunchResult
nodes.summary: Result payload returned to the frontend after successfully launching an agent run.

nodes.name: WorkItemLaunchRequest
nodes.summary: Request payload for launching an agent run scoped to a specific work item.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the session subsystem, re-exporting the compaction, exec_modes, file_registry, gateway_pipeline, goal_loop, housekeeper_compaction, launch, overrides, persistence, plan_mode, project_init, prompt, recovery, scheduler, session_id, title, turn, types, wingman, and workspace submodules.

nodes.name: overrides.rs
nodes.summary: Defines session-level override flags (workspace path override and UI animation toggle) that can be applied on top of an agent definition's defaults.

nodes.name: SessionOverrides
nodes.summary: Holds per-session override values such as workspace path and UI animation preference.

nodes.name: migration.rs
nodes.summary: Applies idempotent SQLite schema migrations for the unified session table, adding new columns via best-effort ALTER TABLE statements guarded against 'duplicate column' errors.

nodes.name: ensure_unified_schema
nodes.summary: Runs the full set of ALTER TABLE migrations needed to bring the sessions table schema up to date, tolerating already-applied migrations.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel re-exporting the session CRUD submodules: migration, ops, record, and workspace (plus ops_tests under test cfg).

nodes.name: ops.rs
nodes.summary: Core SQLite CRUD operations for the unified sessions table: create/read/update/delete, status transitions, mirror-hook notifications, and queries for stale, child, and parent sessions.

nodes.name: upsert_session
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a session's full record in the unified sessions table.

nodes.name: list_sessions
nodes.summary: Lists sessions matching a filter, excluding archived sessions by default.

nodes.name: mark_stale_running_sessions_abandoned
nodes.summary: Marks sessions stuck in a running state past a staleness threshold as abandoned.

nodes.name: update_status
nodes.summary: Updates a session's status column.

nodes.name: finalize_terminal_turn_status
nodes.summary: Finalizes a session's status based on its turn's terminal outcome, recording a completion marker.

nodes.name: reconcile_sessions_with_terminal_turn_markers
nodes.summary: Repairs sessions whose status is out of sync with their persisted terminal turn markers.

nodes.name: update_work_item_link
nodes.summary: Links a session to a work item, org, and project for tracking purposes.

nodes.name: update_org_member_id
nodes.summary: Updates the agent-org member id associated with a session.

nodes.name: update_name
nodes.summary: Updates a session's display name.

nodes.name: update_model
nodes.summary: Updates the model configured for a session.

nodes.name: update_account_id
nodes.summary: Updates the account id configured for a session.

nodes.name: update_model_and_account
nodes.summary: Atomically updates both the model and account id for a session.

nodes.name: update_agent_exec_mode
nodes.summary: Updates a session's agent execution mode.

nodes.name: update_draft_text_with_conn
nodes.summary: Updates a session's saved draft text using a provided database connection.

nodes.name: update_reply_target_event_id
nodes.summary: Updates the reply-target event id associated with a session.

nodes.name: update_reply_target_event_id_with_conn
nodes.summary: Updates a session's reply-target event id using a provided database connection.

nodes.name: update_pinned
nodes.summary: Updates a session's pinned flag.

nodes.name: backfill_agent_definition_id
nodes.summary: Backfills the agent_definition_id column for legacy sessions missing it.

nodes.name: delete_session
nodes.summary: Deletes a session and all of its associated rows (messages, metadata) from the database.

nodes.name: get_child_sessions
nodes.summary: Retrieves all child sessions of a given parent session.

nodes.name: ops_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the session CRUD operations covering status filter round-tripping, default-filter archival exclusion, and terminal-turn-status reconciliation.

nodes.name: filter_status_round_trips_through_session_status_as_str
nodes.summary: Tests that session status filters round-trip correctly through their string representation.

nodes.name: seed_session
nodes.summary: Test helper that seeds a session row with a given id and status.

nodes.name: list_sessions_default_filter_excludes_archived
nodes.summary: Tests that the default session list filter excludes archived sessions.

nodes.name: terminal_turn_finalize_updates_session_status_and_marker
nodes.summary: Tests that finalizing a terminal turn updates both session status and the completion marker.

nodes.name: reconcile_repairs_running_rows_with_terminal_turn_markers
nodes.summary: Tests that reconciliation repairs running session rows using terminal turn markers.
